question: Should the ontology-integration implementation owner accept this exact D65-S6 binding candidate as the implementation boundary for D65-S7?

options.label: Accept the exact binding candidate
options.effect: Select only these exact existing artifacts, symbols, and prospective targets; pass G-D65-BINDING and make D65-S7 separately eligible.

options.label: Require amendments
options.effect: Keep G-D65-BINDING blocked and return the candidate for an exact bounded revision.

options.label: Defer
options.effect: Preserve the candidate as evidence and keep G-D65-BINDING blocked.

options.label: Stop
options.effect: Stop this integration successor without changing admitted predecessors.

claim_ceiling: Decision request only. No option is selected and no implementation, conformance, migration, cutover, publication, deployment, or external effect is authorized.
